title: Happiness
english_paragraphs: A couple had been married for a year. The wife was rather innocent and had brought her husband many happy moments and memories.

One day, the husband upset his wife over something small. She kept saying to him, “I don’t like you. I don’t like you…” After she had repeated it many times, he laughed and said, “Honey, are you a tape recorder?” She went right on repeating herself. He interrupted her: “Honey, side A is finished. It’s time for side B.” She paused for a moment, then began, “I still don’t like you. I still don’t like you…” Again, she said it many times. Her husband said, “Honey, the tape recorder is broken.” At that, she couldn’t help laughing. “The tape recorder isn’t broken,” she said. “But I forgive you.”
Happiness is actually simple. If we take care of our relationship and look after each other, happiness is right beside us.
english_full:
A couple had been married for a year. The wife was rather innocent and had brought her husband many happy moments and memories.

One day, the husband upset his wife over something small. She kept saying to him, “I don’t like you. I don’t like you…” After she had repeated it many times, he laughed and said, “Honey, are you a tape recorder?” She went right on repeating herself. He interrupted her: “Honey, side A is finished. It’s time for side B.” She paused for a moment, then began, “I still don’t like you. I still don’t like you…” Again, she said it many times. Her husband said, “Honey, the tape recorder is broken.” At that, she couldn’t help laughing. “The tape recorder isn’t broken,” she said. “But I forgive you.”

Happiness is actually simple. If we take care of our relationship and look after each other, happiness is right beside us.
russian_paragraphs: О́дная па́ра была́ заму́жем уже год. Жена́ была́ лу́чше неви́нной и прино́сила своему́ му́жу мно́го счастливых моме́нтов и воспомина́ний.

Одна́жды муж расстро́ил свою́ жену́ по какому́-то ма́ленькому пово́ду. Она́ продолжа́ла гово́рить ему́: «Я не люблю́ те́бя. Я не люблю́ те́бя…» По́сле того́ как она́ повто́рила это мно́го раз, он за́смялся и ска́зал: «Доро́гая, ты же магнито́фон?» Она́ продолжа́ла повторя́ть себя́. Он преры́вал её: «Доро́гая, сторона́ А зака́нчена. Вре́мя стороны́ Б.» Она́ па́узила на моме́нт, а потом начала́: «Я по́-прежнему не люблю́ те́бя. Я по́-прежнему не люблю́ те́бя…» Снова́ она́ ска́зала это мно́го раз. Муж ска́зал: «Доро́гая, магнито́фон сло́ман.» На это́ она́ не смогла́ не за́смяться. «Магнито́фон не сло́ман,» ска́зала она́. «Но я проща́ю те́бя.»
Сча́стье факти́чески просто́. Если́ мы забо́тимся о своих отноше́ниях и пригля́дываем друг за др́угом, сча́стье рядом с нами.
reading_paragraphs: Ódnaya pára bylá zamúzhem uzhe god. Zhená bylá lúchshe nevínnoy i prinostila svóyemu múzhu mnógo schastlivykh momeńtov i vospominániy.

Odnázhdy múzh rasstróil svoyú zhenú po kakomú-to mál'en'komu povódu. Oná prodolzhalá govórit' yemú: «Ya ne lyubлю́ tébya. Ya ne lyubлю́ tébya…» Pósle tógo kak oná povtórila eto mnógo raz, on zaśmialsya i skázal: «Dorogáya, ty zhe magnitofón?» Oná prodolzhalá povtoryát' sebyá. On prerýval yé: «Dorogáya, storoná A zakónchena. Vremya storoný B.» Oná páuzila na momeńt, a potóm nachalá: «Ya po-prézhnemu ne lyubлю́ tébya. Ya po-prézhnemu ne lyubлю́ tébya…» Snová oná skázala eto mnógo raz. Múzh skázal: «Dorogáya, magnitofón slóman.» Na éto oná ne smoglá ne zasмyat'sya. «Magnitofón ne slóman,» skázala oná. «No ya proshcháю tébya.»
Schást'e faktichéski prósto. Yeslí my zabotímsya o svoikh otnoshéniyakh i priglýadyvayem drug za drúgom, schást'e rýadom s nami.
